resources.string: Your keys are backed up with your password. We\'ll email you a code to unlock them here.
There\'s no key backup for your current password (for example after a password reset), so use another phone or your recovery key.
We sent a code to %1$s. Enter it to unlock your messages on this phone.
Your password opens the backup on this phone.
On: a new phone needs your password and a code sent to your email
Off: a new phone needs your recovery key or another phone

Your keys are locked with your password before they leave this phone. The server can\'t open them on its own, but it does see your password when you sign in, so your recovery key is still the strongest way back. Resetting a forgotten password turns the backup off.
Enter your password to turn it on
